typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		MOFFIC as string,
		MACCT as string,
		MTE as double,
		MCLASS as string,
		YNA1 as string,
		MSUBCL as string,
		MATYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of MACCT} = MACCT,
		{Copy of YNA1} = YNA1,
		{Copy of MCLASS} = MCLASS,
		{Copy of MATYPE} = MATYPE,
		{Copy of MOFFIC} = MOFFIC,
		{Copy of EFFDATE} = EFFDATE,
		{Copy of MTE} = MTE,
		{Copy of MSUBCL} = MSUBCL) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 sink(input(
		MSUBCL as string,
		MOFFIC as string,
		MCLASS as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MACCT as string,
		YNA1 as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MATYPE as string,
		MTE as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 5000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MSUBCL = {Copy of MSUBCL},
		MOFFIC = {Copy of MOFFIC},
		MCLASS = {Copy of MCLASS},
		EFFDATE = {Copy of EFFDATE},
		MACCT = {Copy of MACCT},
		YNA1 = {Copy of YNA1},
		loadDate,
		MATYPE = {Copy of MATYPE},
		MTE = {Copy of MTE}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
